metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Delve into Darkness Beyond Limits!

Twinkling city lights and a starry sky become obscured in darkness as Mega Darkrai ex arrives with mystery and malice! But Mega Zeraora ex fights back with thunderous strikes of lightning, leading the way for Mega Chandelure ex, Mega Excadrill ex, and more to join the fray. Shadows deepen and nightmares become reality in the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Pitch Black expansion! Each blister comes with 3 booster packs and a promotional card.
